items.title: vixhal-baraiya/qwenFS — Qwen3.5-2B with a filesystem compiled and inserted directly into its weights.
items.summary: qwenFS is an experimental model: Qwen3.5-2B with a filesystem compiled and inserted directly into its weights. It is not a plugin, a tool server or a database behind an API. The filesystem is 8 transformer layers in front of Qwen's own 24, and none of their weights are learned: every one is set by construction. Qwen saves, reads, organizes and links its own files through its normal tool calls, and the model answers every call itself. The circuit reads each call as Qwen writes it, keying on the single tokens Qwen's tool-call format always uses (=name, =text, =target, >, newline, </tool_call>, …).
